title: Do not mutate user-declared model_config in ConfigWrapper
answers: Why is Model.model_config mutated or populated with validate_by_name?
Why does child model inherit validate_by_name even when setting populate_by_name=False?
How does ConfigWrapper handle deprecated and default config without mutating model_config?
body:
Symptom: Inspecting Model.model_config reveals unexpected keys like validate_by_name, or child models fail to override populate_by_name when inheriting from a parent model.
Root cause: pydantic/_internal/_config.py:ConfigWrapper.core_config mutated the input config_dict in place when filling backwards-compatibility defaults.
Fix pattern: Copy user config in pydantic/_internal/_config.py:prepare_config and compute resolved settings into a separate effective_config via pydantic/_internal/_config.py:_build_effective_config.
Constraints: Applies to configuration dictionary resolution in BaseModel and dataclasses; config consumers must read effective_config while config_dict remains unmodified for inheritance.
applies: Model and dataclass configuration resolution and inheritance in pydantic/_internal/_config.py
